actions-list.actionItem: Pursuant to the order of yesterday, the Journal of the proceedings of the Senate was deemed approved to date.
Pursuant to the order of yesterday,the morning hour being deemed expired, and the times for the recognition of the two leaders being reserved.
The following transactions of morning business occurred on today.

H.R. 2347 (Rep. Smucker):
        A bill to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to exclude from gross income any damages, other than punitive damages, received on account of any sexual acts or sexual contact.

        -- Considered by Senate.

        -- Cloture motion on the measure presented in Senate.

 H.R. 8552 (Rep. Luttrell):
        A bill to increase, effective as of December 1, 2026, the rates of compensation for veterans with service-connected disabilities and the rates of dependency and indemnity compensation for thesurvivors of certain disabled veterans, and for other purposes.

        -- Passed Senate without amendment by Voice Vote.


 S.Res. 956 (Sen. Moody):
        A resolution honoring the service and sacrifice ofthe veterans of the United States on Veterans Day, 2026.

        -- Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent.


 S.Res. 957 (Sen. Shaheen):
        A resolution expressing support for the designation of November 15, 2026, as "National Warrior Call Day" and recognizing the importance of connecting members of the Armed Forces and veterans in the United States to support structures necessary to transitionfrom the battlefield, especially peer-to-peer connection.

        -- Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent.


 S.Res. 958 (Sen. Ernst):
        A resolution recognizing the week of November 9 through November 13, 2026, as "National Veterans Small Business Week".

        -- Submitted in the Senate, considered, and agreed to without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent.
